hemoglobin.high_note: Elevated hemoglobin — consider polycythemia, dehydration, or chronic hypoxia
hemoglobin.low_note: Low hemoglobin — evaluate for anemia (iron deficiency, B12, chronic disease)
hemoglobin.critical_note: CRITICAL hemoglobin — transfusion may be indicated

wbc.high_note: Leukocytosis — consider infection, inflammation, or hematologic malignancy
wbc.low_note: Leukopenia — evaluate for bone marrow suppression, viral infection
wbc.critical_note: CRITICAL WBC — immediate hematology consult recommended

platelets.high_note: Thrombocytosis — consider reactive vs. primary cause
platelets.low_note: Thrombocytopenia — assess bleeding risk, consider ITP, DIC, or drug-induced
platelets.critical_note: CRITICAL platelet count — high risk of spontaneous bleeding or thrombosis

sodium.high_note: Hypernatremia — assess hydration status, consider diabetes insipidus
sodium.low_note: Hyponatremia — evaluate volume status, consider SIADH
sodium.critical_note: CRITICAL sodium — risk of seizures, cerebral edema, or osmotic demyelination

potassium.high_note: Hyperkalemia — obtain ECG, consider renal function and medication review
potassium.low_note: Hypokalemia — risk of arrhythmias, assess magnesium and medications
potassium.critical_note: CRITICAL potassium — immediate cardiac monitoring and treatment required

creatinine.high_note: Elevated creatinine — evaluate for acute kidney injury or chronic kidney disease
creatinine.low_note: Low creatinine — may indicate low muscle mass
creatinine.critical_note: CRITICAL creatinine — emergent nephrology consult, consider dialysis

bun.high_note: Elevated BUN — consider dehydration, GI bleed, or renal dysfunction
bun.low_note: Low BUN — may indicate liver disease or malnutrition
bun.critical_note: CRITICAL BUN — severe azotemia, assess for uremic symptoms

glucose.high_note: Hyperglycemia — assess for diabetes, stress response, or medication effect
glucose.low_note: Hypoglycemia — assess for insulin excess, liver disease, or sepsis
glucose.critical_note: CRITICAL glucose — immediate intervention required (D50 or insulin)

troponin.high_note: Elevated troponin — evaluate for acute coronary syndrome, myocarditis, PE
troponin.critical_note: CRITICAL troponin — high suspicion for STEMI, activate cath lab protocol

alt.high_note: Elevated ALT — hepatocellular injury, consider hepatitis, medications, NAFLD
alt.critical_note: CRITICAL ALT — acute liver injury, assess for acetaminophen toxicity or viral hepatitis

ast.high_note: Elevated AST — consider hepatic, cardiac, or muscular source
ast.critical_note: CRITICAL AST — acute liver or muscle injury

lactate.high_note: Elevated lactate — consider tissue hypoperfusion, sepsis, or ischemia
lactate.critical_note: CRITICAL lactate — severe tissue hypoperfusion, likely septic shock

inr.high_note: Elevated INR — assess for liver disease, warfarin effect, or coagulopathy
inr.critical_note: CRITICAL INR — high bleeding risk, consider FFP or vitamin K

d-dimer.high_note: Elevated D-dimer — consider PE, DVT, DIC, or post-surgical state
d-dimer.low_note: D-dimer negative — low probability of thromboembolic event
d-dimer.critical_note: CRITICAL D-dimer — strongly suggestive of major thromboembolic event or DIC

bnp.high_note: Elevated BNP — suggestive of heart failure, correlate with clinical presentation
bnp.low_note: BNP normal — heart failure less likely
bnp.critical_note: CRITICAL BNP — severe heart failure, assess volume status and cardiac function
